asset_register.title: Asset register
asset_register.description: Every machine on the books, with what it is and where it is.

asset_status.title: Asset status history
asset_status.description: How machine status changed over a period, and why.

asset_transfer.title: Asset transfers
asset_transfer.description: Machines moved between factories and locations, including those still in transit.

maintenance_history.title: Maintenance history
maintenance_history.description: What was done to a machine, when, and what it cost.

pm_compliance.title: PM compliance
pm_compliance.description: Preventive maintenance completed within its grace period, per machine.

overdue_maintenance.title: Overdue maintenance
overdue_maintenance.description: What is late right now, past its grace period.

breakdown_analysis.title: Breakdown analysis
breakdown_analysis.description: Every stoppage with its full timestamp chain.

root_cause.title: Root cause analysis
root_cause.description: Failures grouped by cause and failure code, with the downtime each caused.

downtime.title: Downtime
downtime.description: Measured downtime per stoppage, split into response, repair and hold time.

reliability.title: MTBF and MTTR
reliability.description: Reliability per machine: failures, mean time between them, and mean repair time.

maintenance_cost.title: Maintenance cost
maintenance_cost.description: Posted cost entries with their currency, rate and base amount.

lifecycle_cost.title: Lifecycle cost
lifecycle_cost.description: What each machine has cost since it arrived.

parts_consumption.title: Parts consumption
parts_consumption.description: Which spare parts were consumed, in what quantity and at what value.

inventory_valuation.title: Inventory valuation
inventory_valuation.description: Current stock on hand at weighted average cost.

technician_performance.title: Technician workload
technician_performance.description: Jobs assigned and completed, and labour hours booked.

vendor_performance.title: Vendor performance
vendor_performance.description: Claims filed against each vendor, how many they honoured, and how long they took.

coverage_expiry.title: Warranty and AMC expiry
coverage_expiry.description: Cover running out, soonest first, with what it will cost to keep.

item_stock_valuation.title: Item stock valuation
item_stock_valuation.description: What the item store holds and what it is worth, at weighted average cost.

item_reserved_vs_available.title: Reserved vs available
item_reserved_vs_available.description: What is spoken for and by whom, beside what is still free to issue.

item_stock_ageing.title: Stock ageing
item_stock_ageing.description: How long stock has sat, measured from the last time any of it arrived.

item_slow_moving.title: Slow and non-moving stock
item_slow_moving.description: Stock nobody has drawn on inside the window, and stock never issued at all.

item_lot_expiry.title: Lot expiry
item_lot_expiry.description: Dye and chemical lots still in stock, nearest expiry first.

fabric_roll_ledger.title: Roll ledger
fabric_roll_ledger.description: Every fabric roll, its shade and lot, where it is and what it is worth.

fabric_shade_stock.title: Shade-wise stock
fabric_shade_stock.description: Fabric grouped by shade and band — what can actually be cut together.

fabric_inspection_register.title: Inspection register
fabric_inspection_register.description: Rolls inspected in the period, with grade, points and defects.

fabric_roll_lineage.title: Split and merge history
fabric_roll_lineage.description: Rolls cut from another roll, or merged into one, with the piece they came from.

procurement_pending_requisitions.title: Pending purchase requisitions
procurement_pending_requisitions.description: Requisitions not yet ordered, and which of them are waiting on approval rather than on buying.

procurement_pending_orders.title: Pending purchase orders
procurement_pending_orders.description: Ordered and not yet received, line by line, with what is overdue against the date promised.

procurement_fabric_bookings.title: Fabric booking status
procurement_fabric_bookings.description: Fabric held with a mill, and whether it has turned into a requisition yet.

procurement_lc_outstanding.title: LC outstanding
procurement_lc_outstanding.description: Letters of credit still open, nearest expiry first, with their variance against the order.

procurement_shipment_eta.title: Shipment ETA
procurement_shipment_eta.description: What is on the water, when it lands, and how it ran against the ETA first promised.

procurement_landed_cost_summary.title: Landed cost summary
procurement_landed_cost_summary.description: What freight, duty and clearing added to each consignment, as a percentage of the goods.

procurement_return_register.title: Purchase return register
procurement_return_register.description: Goods returned to suppliers, including those approved but not yet sent out.

procurement_claim_register.title: Claim register
procurement_claim_register.description: Money claimed from suppliers in the period, and how much has been recovered.

procurement_advance_outstanding.title: Advance outstanding
procurement_advance_outstanding.description: Money paid to suppliers and not yet worked off, oldest first.

procurement_supplier_scorecard.title: Supplier scorecard
procurement_supplier_scorecard.description: How each supplier scored on delivery, quality, price and claims, with the measures that counted.

requisition_register.title: Floor requisition register
requisition_register.description: Every floor requisition in the period, by department and by requester.

requisition_pending.title: Pending floor requisitions
requisition_pending.description: What the floor is still waiting for, line by line, and how long it has waited.

requisition_auto_pr_trace.title: Shortage to purchase requisition
requisition_auto_pr_trace.description: Floor shortages and the purchase requisitions they raised, followed either way.

requisition_consumption.title: Consumption by person and item
requisition_consumption.description: What each person drew from the store, net of returnable stock that came back.

requisition_borrowed_items.title: Borrowed items
requisition_borrowed_items.description: Returnable stock still out, with what is overdue against the factory’s own limit.

compliance_bond_utilisation.title: Bond utilisation
compliance_bond_utilisation.description: What each licence entitles the factory to import, against what has actually arrived.

compliance_ud_reconciliation.title: UD/UP vs actual consumption
compliance_ud_reconciliation.description: What each declaration told customs would be consumed, against what the store actually issued.

compliance_duty_summary.title: Duty exemption summary
compliance_duty_summary.description: Duty that fell due when goods left the bond, and what took them out of it.

pdf_truncated: Only the first :n rows are in this PDF — export Excel for the whole report.

qt_daily_summary.title: Daily quality summary
qt_daily_summary.description: Day by day, every line and job: target, RFT, defect, rectify, reject, pass, DHU, RFT %, achievement and efficiency.

qt_defect_analysis.title: Defect analysis
qt_defect_analysis.description: Each defect over the period: how often it was found, its share of the section, and on how many lines and jobs.

qt_inspector_performance.title: QC performance
qt_inspector_performance.description: Each QC over the period: days tapped, garments checked, defects found and the DHU they recorded.

qt_hourly_tally.title: Hourly tally
qt_hourly_tally.description: The tally sheet for every line: day, line and hour with RFT, defect, rectify, reject, pass and DHU.
